_comment: The ofek subject sidecar. Everything the pipeline needs to know about THIS
instrument lives here; everything about the pipeline itself lives in etc/go/.
Validated by etc/go/lib/subject.mjs. Free-prose idiosyncrasies live in
NOTES.md, which no script reads. All paths are repo-root-relative.
OFEK HADASH IS NOT LEGISLATION, and a reader who takes it for a statute will
misread the whole subject. It is a collective agreement between the State of
Israel and the Teachers' Union, layered with later collective agreements,
decisions of a joint bipartite follow-up committee (vaadat maakav) that the
agreements make binding, and ministry circulars. The one Act in the picture --
the 2025 budget law -- works by REFERRING BACK to an approved collective
agreement rather than by setting a rate itself, so even the statutory layer
routes through the agreements.
THE SOURCE IS NOT OFFICIAL, and that matters more here than it would for a
statute. 'source_url' is a third-party published corpus of 282 documents in
Akoma Ntoso, not the Ministry of Education and not Reshumot. The encoding's
SOURCE-LICENSE.md carries TWO open questions rather than the usual one, and
the corpus repository has no LICENSE file at all. Read that file before
republishing anything this subject produces.
WHERE THE MODULES LIVE. Under jl4/examples/canon/, the vendored mirror of
legalese/canon (jl4/examples/canon/README.md), and the subject IS blessed in
etc/canon-pin.json as of 2026-09-19 — canon e29c69a3 supplied the 36 goldens
whose absence had kept it out. DO NOT EDIT THOSE FILES HERE. The mirror is
generated; a change to the encoding is made in canon and arrives through
`sync-canon.mjs --bump`, and the Canon Mirror CI job fails when this tree and
canon at the pin disagree.
THE MODULE SET IS EIGHT FILES AND THE NINTH IS DELIBERATELY OMITTED.
ofek-catala.l4 is GENERATED -- source/build-catala-module.py flattens the
eight into the single module `l4 catala` can compile, because that backend
compiles one module at a time. Declaring it would re-check the same rules
under a second name and add its 9 assertions to a count that already covers
them, which is the double-count encoding.modules refuses for a repeated path
and cannot detect for a re-spelling. Measured 2026-09-16: 263 assertions over
all nine modules, 254 over the declared eight, 9 in ofek-catala.l4.
FLOORS ARE MEASURED, NOT ASPIRATIONAL.
checks.min_assertions = 254. MEASURED 2026-09-16 with
etc/go/lib/assert-report.mjs over `l4 run --json` for each declared module:
ofek-cases 49, ofek-salary-table 47, ofek-worktime 41, ofek-placement 37,
ofek-supplements 37, ofek-fiscal-2025 37, ofek-domain 6, ofek-pay 0 -- 254
executed, 0 failed. That is the EXECUTED count out of results[], never a
grep for '#ASSERT'. It agrees digit-for-digit with the 254 the encoding's
own encoding.json records, which is the expected result and is recorded
rather than assumed. Raise it when the corpus grows; never lower it.
ofek-pay.l4 contributing 0 is a fact about the file, not a gap: it is the
assembly module -- it composes the components the other seven decide and
carries the one @export the single-artifact legs run from -- and every
scenario that exercises it lives in ofek-cases.l4, which imports it.
min_dated_arms = 0, and 0 is the measured population: `grep -c 'RULES
EFFECTIVE DATE'` returns 0 for all nine modules. There is no rule-version
axis. That is a real encoding decision and not an omission -- the 2025-2026
wage reduction is modelled as an ordinary fiscal-year input threaded
through ofek-fiscal-2025.l4 rather than as a dated arm over the rules -- so
a 0 floor makes p3-check report the temporal-closure sub-check NOT CHECKED
rather than printing a vacuous 'all 0 dated arm(s) carry an @ref'.
NO 'natlang_sources' AND NO 'comparison', which are optional and omitted on
purpose. The deposits they name DO exist -- the encoding's own
registers/source-bundle.json, document-register.json and fork-register.json,
the last carrying 13 forks -- but they live in canon and the mirror's
allowlist does not carry registers/. Declaring a path this repository cannot
hold would turn an honest silence into a permanent SKIPPED naming a file
nobody can deposit. The consequence is stated plainly: p1-ingest, p2-sweep,
p4-forks and p8-diff are not reachable for this subject, so no run of it is
evidence about the sweep or the fork register. Widen the allowlist first if
that is wanted.
WHICH LEGS ARE DECLARED, AND WHY THE REST ARE NOT. The driver declares a
projection leg iff it appears here, so an omitted leg is an honest silence
rather than a permanent red.
p7-akn    declared. `l4 render --format akn` emits on any module that
typechecks; probed 2026-09-16 on ofek-pay.l4 and it does. Its
oracle is well-formedness only, so the leg cannot raise the run
verdict -- it reports UNVERIFIED by construction.
p7-mcp    declared. Three modules carry an @export (ofek-pay.l4,
ofek-placement.l4 and the generated ofek-catala.l4), so there is
a deployable surface and main is one of them. With no
JL4_GO_SERVICE_URL the leg reports SKIPPED and still records the
zip.
p7-bpmn and p7-lts are NOT declared. Every module is entirely
CONSTITUTIVE: `grep -cE '\b(MUST|MAY|SHANT)\b'` returns 0 for all nine,
and `l4 export ofek-pay.l4 --to bpmn` answers 'No regulative rules found in
module' (measured 2026-09-16). The subject decides what a teacher is PAID;
it states no obligation, so there is no process to draw and no transition
system to walk. Declaring either leg would be a guaranteed blocker on every
run, which is noise rather than measurement.
p7-tnr is NOT declared, and the reason CHANGED on 2026-09-19 rather than
going away. It used to be 'this encoding has no .nlg.golden'. It now has
nine. The reason now is that the leg would be VACUOUS: p7-tnr.sh pairs
GO_S_ENCODING -- main, not the module set -- with the declared golden, and
main here is ofek-pay.l4, the assembly module, which carries no directive
to linearise. MEASURED 2026-09-19: `l4 nlg ofek-pay.l4` emits 0 bytes and
tests/ofek-pay.nlg.golden is 0 bytes, so the leg's diff would compare
nothing against nothing and PASS on every run forever. That is a leg that
cannot go red, which is worth less than an honest silence, and it is the
same refusal min_dated_arms=0 makes for the temporal sub-check.
Do NOT fix this by repointing encoding.main at ofek-cases.l4: main is the
ENTRY module the single-artifact legs export from, ofek-cases.l4 carries no
@export, and moving it would break p7-mcp and p7-akn to buy a golden diff.
The real fix is a p7-tnr that takes a module SET, as p3-check and p6-tests
already do; declare the leg in the change that lands it.
p7-wizard is NOT declared: there is no wizard module. p7-dmn, p7-dmn-md
and p7-ladder are NOT declared: each needs committed goldens or an npm demo
entry this subject does not have.
THE CANON DESTINATION, AND WHY primary_row SAYS 'legalese'. canon.subject_path
is a fact about the law -- where in legalese/canon this body of law is filed --
so it lives here. The BRANCH is a fact about who is depositing and is resolved
per-run by lib/canon-destination.mjs, which is why it is absent.
primary_row is separate from subject_path because the two words name different
things and only one of them is a row. 'primary' is THIS DRIVER'S SELECTOR for
the committed encoding -- what `--encoding primary` picks -- and canon rules
that no row is primary, so subject.mjs refuses `primary` as a row name
outright. The encoding this sidecar calls `primary` is filed in canon under
subjects/il/ofek-hadash-2008/encodings/legalese/, and that is the string that
belongs here: a name naming its occasion, as every other canon row does. A
reader following p10's destination must land on the directory that exists.
display_name: Ofek Hadash — the collective agreements that set Israeli teachers' pay
citation: Collective agreement of 25 December 2008 between the State of Israel and the Teachers' Union of Israel implementing the Ofek Hadash reform, as amended — in particular by the wage agreement of 19 October 2022, the follow-up committee decision of 14 January 2025, and the approved collective agreement of 29 June 2026 made under Chapter 9 of the Law for the Achievement of Budget Objectives and Implementation of Economic Policy for the 2025 Budget Year (Legislative Amendments) 5785-2025
